v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given a workday with no events, when a slot is requested, then all slots that are available should be returned.
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given an event from 10:00 - 11:00, when a slot to requests, then slots overlapping the event must not be returned
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given events outside working hours, when a slot is requested, then system should set only within valid working hour slots.
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given a meeting duration longer than available slot, when slot is requested, system should not suggest that slot.
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given a -ve or 0 meeting duration, when requested a slot, system should return empty list.
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given there are back to back events with no gaps, when a slot is requested, then no slots should be suggested b/w them.

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_1: No meetings must start or overlap lunch break.
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Suggested meeting slots can't overlap with existing events
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_3: All time inputs are in the 24H format.
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Events and slots do not cross midnight.
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_6: The function always returns a list of strings.

v1_human_g2_goal: The objective of the system is to identify all valid meeting start times on a given day that fit within working hours and do not conflict with existing calendar events.
v1_human_g2_input:
Events: the list of events that are already planned in the calendar. Format - dictionary with 2 keys of type string.

Meeting-duration: desired meeting duration. Type int, valid values => five values of given structure.

day: day of the week which is being chosen. Type string. Valid values: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
v1_human_g2_output: The function returns valid_slots. These are the slots that are available, i.e, have no meetings or not within working hours and can have a new scheduled meeting. The function returns a list of meetings start times in 24-H format
